reviews.title: Fits MSI Stealth 14in studio
reviews.comment: I have an MSI Stealth 14in studio A13VF. Took 5 minutes to swap, perfect fit, no issues with boot or throttling, fast, large capacity. No complaints here.
reviews.author: Tanner Eischen

reviews.title: Top notch, great quality, no sacrifices.
reviews.comment: Top quality, quick and easy installation. The system recognized it immediately, picked up on the settings/timing in my Omen 16 Max, and runs like a dream. Of note, after installing, it may take 45-60 seconds for the PC to post for the first time, so if it doesn't boot immediately, you may just need to give it a little time to run it's checks and balances. After the first boot, it's smooth sailing. Great price/value for the quality. Now my system laughs at games or whatever I want to throw at it.

reviews.title: Great memory.  Has been stable for a month in new laptop.
reviews.comment:
Summary: I don't think you can go wrong with this memory.  Using in Dell XPS 17 9730.
Pros: Fast, Reliable
Cons:  A little pricey, hard to get at this time in the US for some reason
Detail:  As anyone who is somewhat technically savvy knows when you buy a new laptop the manufacturers always overcharge for memory.  I find it's always much cheaper to buy the lowest amount you can for the laptop you can and replace with new memory right away.  You can literally throw the OEM memory away and buy new and same $100 or more in the process.  In this case I also went from 4800 to 5200 speed as well.  Why did it not register at 5600 like advertised you ask?  This is not Kingston's fault.  In my case it's because there is a known issue with Intel chipsets at 64GB of memory.  I knew this before buying and only expected to get 5200.  Not sure if AMD has this issue as well, but a lot of Intel based systems do, even the top of the line Alienware 18 as of the time of this review.
Reseller:  I purchased this item from a reseller out of Texas who had a lot of negative reviews, most which Amazon defended due to manufacturer/supply chain issues.  My delivery was a few days late, but did make it. I was kind of expecting this ahead of time.  I found in my research that this memory isn't common and the reseller probably had to work overtime to get it from Kingston.  My guess is that it had to be imported.  If you find this review and are looking at the same reseller for this product, know that I believe he/she/they are truly trying to do a good job but are in some cases selling products like this that are often hard to get and that is why their reviews aren't all 5-star.
reviews.author: Sam_I_Am

reviews.title: No Need to Adjust Timings
reviews.comment: This is my second time using Kingston Fury RAM.  I installed these in my MSI Vector 16 RTX 5070ti laptop and it booted up fine.  There was no need to adjust timings in the BIOS, as these are already at the factory to run at 5600MT/s.  Stability has been good with no issues at all.  I would buy these again, because I've had good experiences with the Fury brand.  I do a lot of multitasking, so 32 GB is the ideal capacity for my use case.  I recommend either waiting for a sale or doing what I did, save your Amazon Credit Card Reward points to either pay for or offset the cost, because current RAM prices are still higher than they should be.
reviews.author: S. Senior
